no_resampling.check: no resampling of the training set
no_resampling.note: Imbalance is handled by weighting the objective, never by duplicating or synthesising patients. leakage_audit.py is exempt because measuring the reference over-sampling protocol is the point of that module.

imbalance_handling.check: imbalance handled by weighting, not resampling

preprocessing_inside_folds.check: imputer and scaler live inside the CV pipeline
preprocessing_inside_folds.note: Because they are Pipeline steps, scikit-learn refits them on each training fold automatically; fitting them once on the full matrix would leak test-fold statistics into training.

no_identifier_features.check: no feature behaves like a row identifier

test_set_used_once.check: test set is scored, never fitted or tuned on

label_policy.check: 'Not reported' is never relabelled as 'no inhibitor'
label_policy.note: Prevalence of 20.1% matches published epidemiology for severe hemophilia A; relabelling would drive it to 11.4%.

accuracy_reported_with_baseline.check: accuracy reported with its majority-class baseline
